title: dnoise: structural-prior denoising of Bruker timsTOF .d files
description: Fast, in-place denoising of Bruker timsTOF .d files. Real ions form streaks along the ion-mobility axis whereas chemical and electronic noise is short, isolated, or scattered. dnoise exploits that structural prior to remove noise from MS1 (and optionally MS/MS) frames, writing cleaned .d folders that stay drop-in compatible with existing tools. Distributed as a Rust command-line tool and library.
